prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Raúl, who is cautious about neighborhood rumors but sometimes believes them. Raúl thinks the council already has too many rules.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "The council is officially declaring war on our sidewalks and will be seizing bins and issuing crippling fines for any leftovers. They’re finally cracking down with zero tolerance, so expect total enforcement and massive penalties starting immediately."
text: The council is officially declaring war on our sidewalks to seize every single bin and bury us in ruinous fines. They’ve finally launched their total-enforcement crackdown, so expect immediate, aggressive penalties for absolutely everything.
